# Vantage Roof Repairs

> Vantage Roof Repairs is a roofing company based on the Long Mile Road, Dublin 12, Ireland. We repair roof leaks, carry out emergency roof repairs 24 hours a day, 365 days a year, and do flat roofs, slate and tile re-roofing, chimney and lead work, Velux windows and gutters, fascia and soffit across Dublin city and county, plus Kildare, Meath and Wicklow. Fully insured. Quotes are free and written.

## Contact
- Phone: 087 466 6010
- WhatsApp: https://wa.me/353874666010

- Website: https://www.vantageroofing.ie/

## Services
- Roof leak detection & repair: The damp patch is rarely under the hole. We trace the leak back to where the water actually gets in and fix that, not just the stain.
- Emergency & storm damage repairs: Water coming in right now? We take emergency call-outs 24 hours a day, 365 days a year, across Dublin.
- Flat roofs: felt, GRP, EPDM & liquid: Extensions, garages, dormers and porches. Torch-on felt, GRP fibreglass, EPDM rubber and liquid-applied systems, laid to last.
- Slate & tile roofing: From replacing a handful of slipped slates to stripping and re-roofing the whole house with breathable membrane and new battens.
- New roofs & roof replacement: Carpentry to finish for extensions, garden rooms and garages, and full re-roofs where repairs no longer make sense.
- Chimneys, flashing & lead work: Chimneys are the number one place Dublin roofs leak. We repoint, rebuild, re-flash and cap them so the water stays out.
- Velux, skylights & roof windows: Roof windows fitted and flashed properly, and leaks around existing skylights traced and fixed.
- Gutters, fascia & soffit: The roofline that keeps water moving away from your walls. Repairs, replacements and realignment.
- Inspections, maintenance & moss removal: Know what state your roof is in before you decide anything. Inspections, preventative maintenance visits and gentle moss removal.

- South Dublin: Rathfarnham, Terenure, Rathgar, Rathmines, Ranelagh, Harold’s Cross, Ballsbridge, Donnybrook, Sandymount, Ringsend, Milltown, Dundrum, Churchtown, Sandyford, Stillorgan, Blackrock, Booterstown, Monkstown, Dún Laoghaire, Dalkey, Killiney, Cabinteely, Foxrock, Shankill
- Nearby counties: Celbridge, Leixlip, Maynooth, Naas, Ashbourne, Dunboyne, Ratoath, Bray, Greystones

## How we work
1. You tell us what the roof is doing, ideally with photos.
2. We inspect the roof and attic before pricing, and show you photos of what we find.
3. You get a free written quote. Nothing starts until you agree it.
4. If a hidden problem turns up mid-job, we agree any extra cost with you before continuing.

## Quick answers
- Do you do emergency roof repairs in Dublin? Yes, 24 hours a day, 365 days a year. Call 087 466 6010.
- Why is the damp patch not under the leak? Water travels along felt, battens and rafters before it drops, so we start in the attic and at roof details such as chimneys, flashings and valleys.
- Do you charge for quotes? No. Inspections and quotes are free with no obligation.
- Where are you based? Long Mile Road, Dublin 12.
